beats.say: 10 weeks: Shakira and Burna Boy's Dai Dai tops the global chart. The collaboration hits a new milestone.
Billboard reports the song nets a milestone tenth week at number one on the Global Excl. U.S. chart. That is ten consecutive weeks leading the tally.
The same publication notes it also leads the Billboard Global 200 for a seventh week. The track dominates both worldwide rankings simultaneously.
Billboard adds that the track drew 36.7 million streams and sold 4,000 copies worldwide in the latest tracking week. Those numbers keep the streak alive.
That weekly haul averages over five million streams each day, a pace few songs sustain. The momentum shows no sign of slowing.
10 weeks at the summit, and the streak goes on. 10 weeks: Shakira and Burna Boy's Dai Dai tops the global chart.

facts: Shakira and Burna Boy's Dai Dai reaches a 10th week at No. 1 on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart.
